ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass via SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96() returning 0
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds (line 847-849) checks sqrtPriceX96==0 and reverts with AMMStandardHook__InvalidPrice(). CLOBTransferHandler._enforceTokenHooks delegates to token hook's validateHandlerOrder which receives the sqrtPriceX96 computed by CLOBHelper.calculateFixedInput — a different code path that doesn't use computeRatioX96. No insolvency vector: even if a CLOB order bypassed max-only pricing bounds (min=0, max>0), the fill math prices correctly at the attacker's sqrtPriceX96, meaning the attacker sells at a worse price than max — self-harm, not profit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call bypasses pricing enforcement
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler's settlement callback (line 229-231) requires msg.sender==AMM. All other external functions (lines 357, 395, 439, 490) are nonReentrant maker operations (deposit, withdraw, cancel, placeOrder) that don't execute swaps. No path to bypass beforeSwap/afterSwap pricing validation by calling the handler directly.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap between CreatorHookSettingsRegistry and AMMStandardHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry.setTokenSettings (line 377) sets memSettings.initialized=true BEFORE writing to _tokenSettings[token] storage. Sync to hooks via registryUpdateTokenSettings (lines 396-397) uses the same settings struct. The initialized field cannot desync because it's set server-side before storage write. Omitting hooks from the hooksToSync array is admin-controlled (self-inflicted config error, FP pattern #4 from audit memory).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak in DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds (line 839) writes to DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT in every beforeSwap call. The slot is read in afterSwap (line 844). Transient storage clears at end-of-TX. Within a TX, beforeSwap ALWAYS overwrites the slot, so no stale read from a prior swap. Test C1 (test_C1_transient_storage_isolation_two_swaps_same_tx) confirms isolation between sequential swaps in the same TX.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan profit extraction via add-liquidity/swap/remove-liquidity cycle
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: test_INV_E02_flash_loan_add_swap_remove_no_profit demonstrates attacker balance <= initial after flash loan + swap round trip. Fees consumed on each swap make the cycle unprofitable. test_INV_E02_no_flash_loan_profit additionally tests direct flash loan with fee repayment — balance check enforced at line 3352.

DynamicHelper.computeSwap (line 404) guards fee growth update with `if (swapCache.liquidity > 0)`. Swaps cannot produce output without liquidity, so fee growth only accumulates when there are active positions to collect. test_hypothesis_fee_overflow_extreme_swaps confirms no overflow with extreme swap sequences.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: tokensOwed desync between position and pool accounting
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: In removeLiquidity, reserves are decremented before token transfer. If transfer fails, tokens go to tokensOwed via _storeTokensOwed (line 2937-2948) which uses hash-based storage accumulation. The actual tokens remain in the contract (balance >= reserves + owed). collectTokensOwed draws from real balance. test_hypothesis_tokensOwed_no_double_collect confirms solvency holds after repeated operations.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Rounding asymmetry in add vs remove liquidity paths (dust extraction)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: test_INV_SW03_1000_dust_swaps_no_pool_loss runs 1000 dust-size swaps and verifies pool balance >= reserves + fees after all operations. FeeHelper uses mulDiv for input (rounds down, favoring protocol) and mulDivRoundingUp for output (rounds up against user). Both directions favor the protocol. No cumulative extraction path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Force token.balanceOf to diverge from cached reserves — extract via stale state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Direct ERC20 transfer to AMM increases balanceOf but NOT reserves, creating a surplus (balance > reserves). The AMM uses balance-before/balance-after pattern in _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse (line 2197) which validates actual transfers, not cached amounts. Swaps operate on reserve state, not raw balances. test_hypothesis_balanceOf_divergence_no_extraction confirms no profit extraction after forced divergence.

_setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at line 3190 preserves ENTERED bit (TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags uses `currentGuard & ENTERED | flags`). test_INV_H05_reentrancy_guard_blocks_reentry and test_C10 (multiple reentry vectors) confirm all reentry paths revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction via 100+ tiny swaps compounding truncation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: test_probe_dust_loop_no_extraction and test_INV_SW03_1000_dust_swaps_no_pool_loss both confirm: pool balance >= reserves + fees after 100-1000 dust swaps. Rounding consistently favors protocol.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision across diamond proxy facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule uses diamond storage at slot 0x9A1D (AppStorage). Pool types (DynamicPoolType slot 0, FixedPoolType slots 0-1, SingleProviderPoolType slot 0) are called via regular CALL, not DELEGATECALL. Storage is fully isolated. Slither storage layout analysis confirms no overlap.
